fields.citation_format: How sources are displayed to users
fields.notes: Additional context for teachers and researchers

records.grade_range: Compulsory education Grades 1-9; MathBridge uses primary Grades 1-6
records.citation_format: 教育部《义务教育数学课程标准（2022年版）》
records.notes: Primary national curriculum authority. Primary requirements are organised by learning stages rather than a complete year-by-year textbook sequence.

records.citation_format: 人民教育出版社《义务教育教科书·数学》
records.notes: Umbrella record for PEP primary mathematics textbooks. Always attach edition/year and volume-level evidence before using this source for exact sequencing.

records.citation_format: 人民教育出版社《人教版义务教育数学（一～六年级）新教材简介》
records.notes: Official overview of the new PEP mathematics series aligned to the 2022 curriculum standard. Confirms unit structure, selected sequence changes and selected current unit titles.

records.citation_format: 人民教育出版社《人教版第十二套教材纵览》
records.notes: Confirms the 12th PEP textbook series began use from the 2024 autumn term in starting grades. Exact later-grade mathematics rollout and volume sequencing must be verified with mathematics-specific volume evidence.

records.citation_format: 人民教育出版社小学数学电子教材
records.notes: Official PEP digital textbook portal linked from the PEP homepage. Some indexed digital volumes are earlier editions; edition identity must be checked before sequence extraction.

records.citation_format: 人民教育出版社《同步口算练习册一年级上册》
records.notes: Official PEP product page states the workbook is synchronized by lesson period with the new textbook. The public page does not expose a unit TOC or the textbook ISBN, so use it only as corroborating current-volume evidence.

records.citation_format: Department for Education, National Curriculum in England: Mathematics Programmes of Study
Department for Education, Mathematics Guidance: Key Stages 1 and 2
records.notes: Non-statutory guidance identifying core concepts and showing how understanding develops from Year 1 to Year 6. Particularly useful for MathBridge's 'how' and progression layers.

records.citation_format: NCETM Primary Mastery Professional Development Materials
records.notes: Teaching guidance rather than statutory curriculum. Use to explain representations, sequencing and mastery pedagogy.

records.grade_range: All school phases; MathBridge uses primary application
records.citation_format: NCETM, Five Big Ideas in Teaching for Mastery
records.notes: Defines the five named ideas used by NCETM's teaching-for-mastery programme. It is programme guidance, not evidence that every school in England uses these methods.

records.grade_range: All school phases; MathBridge uses primary application
records.citation_format: NCETM, The Essence of Mathematics Teaching for Mastery
records.notes: States that procedural fluency and conceptual understanding are developed together and that representations/examples are selected to expose structure. Use as NCETM programme guidance, not as a national classroom-frequency claim.

records.citation_format: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics
records.notes: Baseline US comparison framework, not a claim that every US state currently uses Common Core unchanged.

records.grade_range: TK-12; MathBridge primarily uses TK-Grade 6 content
records.citation_format: California Department of Education, 2023 Mathematics Framework
records.notes: State-adopted implementation guidance aligned to California mathematics standards. Chapter 6 covers transitional kindergarten through Grade 5 and is especially relevant to the primary comparison layer.

records.citation_format: Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills for Mathematics, 19 TAC Chapter 111
records.notes: Texas provides a useful non-Common-Core state comparison. Elementary standards were adopted in 2012; current TEA pages continue to identify them as the state standards.
Not a government standard. Use as an illustrative classroom implementation source, especially for lesson structure, task design, routines and coherent sequencing.

records.citation_format: Institute of Education Sciences / What Works Clearinghouse Mathematics Practice Guides
records.notes: Use guide-specific evidence ratings and recommendations rather than treating all IES guidance as a single claim.

records.citation_format: IES/WWC, Developing Effective Fractions Instruction for Kindergarten Through 8th Grade
records.notes: Evidence-reviewed practice guide. Particularly relevant to fractions as numbers, number-line representations, making fraction procedures meaningful, and conceptual ratio/rate/proportion instruction.

records.grade_range: International Grade 4 and Grade 8 assessment frameworks
records.notes: International comparison source; not a national curriculum.
